verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs describe an agent (Claude Code/Codex) claiming an approved task, doing the work, and opening a PR autonomously, with task-executor skills and contracts guiding it (foreloop-docs-3, foreloop-docs-36, foreloop-docs-37, foreloop-docs-39). However, there is no explicit evidence that the agent writes or runs tests as part of that workflow — the closest related capability is a post-hoc automated code review that scores PRs (foreloop-docs-22/23), not test authorship. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or example of the agent generating/executing tests as part of feature implementation, and independent/hands-on confirmation of end-to-end autonomous delivery quality.
